sloka: स तं गृहीत्वा ऽनिलतुल्यवेगं सविस्फुलिङ्गज्वलनप्रकाशम् ।बाणं महेन्द्राशनितुल्यवेगं चिक्षेप सुग्रीववधाय रुष्टः ।। ६.५९.३९ ।।।।
transliteration: sa taṁ gṛhītvā 'nilatulyavegaṁ savisphuliṅgajvalanaprakāśam ।bāṇaṁ mahendrāśanitulyavegaṁ cikṣepa sugrīvavadhāya ruṣṭaḥ ।। 6.59.39 ।।।।

translations.english: Seizing an arrow which shone like sparks of fire and had the speed of wind, nay vied with thunderbolt of Indra in speed, he (Ravana) released an arrow in anger.
